statement: AMD guided Q2 2026 revenue to approximately 11.2 billion dollars plus or minus 300 million, about 46 percent year-over-year growth and about 9 percent sequential growth.
why: Company guidance is the vendor own forward view of order flow, and a guided 46 percent year-over-year increase implies AMD expects accelerator and server demand to keep accelerating.

impact.mechanism: Guidance for higher revenue signals AMD sees continued order intake for Instinct and EPYC, supporting the demand track.

evidence.excerpt: For the second quarter of 2026, AMD expects revenue to be approximately $11.2 billion, plus or minus $300 million.

confidence.basis: Primary source: guidance stated in AMD official earnings release.

dispersion: Stated guidance band is plus or minus 300 million dollars. This is total company revenue, not a data-center-only or GPU-only figure.
